sentences.text: Operational assurance at Alder Creek depends on clear authority, verified equipment state, and records that support later review.
The Control Room Operator remains responsible for deciding whether an automation request is appropriate for current operating conditions.
The Bay Automation Controller shall execute only commands permitted by its approved logic and configured interlocks.
The Feeder Protection Relay shall retain its protective function independently of supervisory communications.
The Protection Relay Engineer reviews protection behavior after material changes and records any unresolved concerns for operational follow-up.
The Station Supervisory Control System presents control indications and command results for operator assessment.
The Sequence Event Archive retains time-ordered records needed to reconstruct significant control and protection events.
The Engineering Workstation shall be used for authorized configuration work under established change control.
The Satellite Time Receiver supports consistent event timing, and time-quality concerns shall be investigated before records are relied upon for sequence analysis.
The Station Gateway shall maintain the defined boundary between station automation and external communications.
The Station DC System shall be confirmed available before switching that depends on station control power.
The Breaker Control Unit shall reject commands that do not satisfy its configured permissive conditions.
Substation Field Crew uses the Isolation Boundary Card to verify the approved work boundary before entering the controlled area.
Substation Field Crew reports unexpected equipment conditions promptly and pauses work when the approved boundary is uncertain.
Switching Desk Coordinator receives the Clearance Handoff Memo and confirms that its clearance status agrees with the active switching record.
Keystone shall confirm that switching authority, equipment state, and communication limits are understood before coordinating any automation-enabled action.
The Substation Supervisor verifies that unresolved risks have an assigned owner and an agreed disposition before normal service is resumed.
The Control Room Operator confirms indications locally when remote status is incomplete, inconsistent, or delayed.
The Protection Relay Engineer assesses unexplained trips and abnormal protection indications before protection is returned to service.
The Maintenance Remote Terminal shall use controlled access, and each maintenance session shall be attributable to an authorized user.
The North Bay Controller shall be checked for expected local behavior after approved configuration work.
The South Bay Controller shall be checked for expected local behavior after approved configuration work.
The North Protection Panel shall remain available for independent protection functions during supervisory control interruptions.
The Transformer Protection Panel shall remain within its approved settings and operating constraints during handover.
Periodic operational reviews shall examine command outcomes, event records, exceptions, and corrective actions so that automation decisions remain traceable and safe.
